notes:
Original and replication main effects matched independently. Replication uses French stimuli with audiovisual presentation. Replication prints F = 3.968 and p < .001; retained as printed without correction. Its narrative qualifies the word length effect as mainly present in the similar condition, without a clear effect-specific replication verdict; reported_success is null.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Experiment and named main effect identify the target; retain printed partial eta-squared without converting to eta-squared.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors describe word length as mainly present in the similar condition; Results call the detected effect substantially smaller than original. This is a qualified effect-specific assessment, rather than full replication.
